'''Joy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] spicelord living during the [[Galactic War]]. Joy and a fellow spicelord [[Love]] accompanied the information broker [[Krata]] during his exchange of information with the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]].
